datasets.pds_dataset_product_name: HiRISE image PSP_001513_1655_RED (Home Plate and vicinity)
datasets.location_coverage: Gusev crater, Home Plate and vicinity (includes Eastern Valley / Tyrone area; figure context map)
datasets.how_used: Used as orbital basemap/context for mapping Home Plate, rover position, and distribution of silica-rich nodular outcrops; used to show locations of Mini-TES targets along the eastern edge of Home Plate (e.g., Fig. 1, Fig. 33).

datasets.measurement_observable: Thermal infrared spectra calibrated to emissivity (used to detect/characterize opal-A and evaluate mirror-dust effects)
datasets.location_coverage: Gusev crater, Spirit traverse around Home Plate (Eastern Valley, Tyrone area, Low Ridge/Troll, North Valley)

(1,2)); P3989 (sol 1186 Kathryn Beare); P3990 (sol 1186 Janice Ohara); P3991 (sol 1189 Virginia Bell); P3992 (sol 1189 Nancy Warren); P3993 (sol 1190 Thelma Hundeby); P3995 (sol 1192 Elizabeth Mahon); P3030 (sol 1193 Alice Blaski); P3044 (sol 1199 Ethel Boyce); P3045 (sol 1199 Joanne Weaver); P3438 (sol 824 Aboa); P3447 (sol 836 Concordia); P3820 (sol 1088 Montalva_1); P3822 (sol 1089 Montalva_2); P3855 (sol 1113 Kadabra); P3994 (sol 1192 Light track); P3129 (sol 1234 Eileen Dean); P3204 (sol 1786 Eric Frank Russell); P3205 (sol 1788 Stapledon); P3207 (sol 1796 Robert Heinlein)

datasets.how_used: Used to (1) document morphology/color of silica-rich nodular outcrops and silica-rich soils; (2) extract multispectral reflectance spectra and compute the ‘hydration signature’ (spectral-parameter thresholds including 934–1009 nm downturn) to map silica-rich/hydrated materials (e.g., Clara Zaph4, Stapledon, and comparisons showing absence on Good Question and Fuzzy Smith); and (3) provide context/targeting for Mini-TES/IDD observations (e.g., circles/regions used for Mini-TES targets and MI frames).

datasets.pds_dataset_product_name: MER Spirit Alpha Particle X-ray Spectrometer (APXS) in-situ elemental chemistry measurements (targets listed in paper)
datasets.measurement_observable: Elemental abundances (Na to Y) / derived oxide wt% (e.g., SiO2, TiO2, SO3)
datasets.acquisition_date_time_range: Sols/targets explicitly discussed in chemical analysis: sol 770 (Fuzzy Smith), sol 1157 (Elizabeth Mahon), sol 1179 (Good Question), sol 1190 (Kenosha Comets), sol 1199 (Lefty Ganote), sol 1225 (Nancy Warren), sol 1230 (Calibration Soil), sol 1251 (Innocent Bystander), sol 1288 (Norma Luker); plus Stapledon chemistry noted as measured on sol 1788 campaign (APXS result cited as ~72 wt% SiO2)
datasets.location_coverage: Gusev crater, Home Plate region (Eastern Valley, top of Home Plate for Fuzzy Smith, North Valley for Stapledon)
datasets.spatial_resolution: Effective APXS field of view ~25 mm diameter (max FOV 38 mm)
datasets.how_used: APXS compositions were used to quantify SiO2 enrichment of soils/outcrops, compare silica-rich materials to typical soil, and perform linear soil-contamination subtraction using ‘Calibration Soil’ (sol 1230) to estimate corrected silica-rich compositions (Table 2; Fig. 15). Stapledon APXS chemistry is used as confirmation of silica enrichment north of Home Plate.

datasets.pds_dataset_product_name: MER Spirit MIMOS II Mössbauer spectrometer (MB) mineralogy/redox measurements (as compiled by Morris et al. 2008)
datasets.measurement_observable: Fe-bearing mineral identification/abundance; Fe3+/Fetotal; Mineralogical Alteration Index (MAI)
datasets.acquisition_date_time_range: Same silica-rich targets measured with APXS except Norma Luker (explicitly noted); includes Kenosha Comets soil, Lefty Ganote soil, Nancy Warren outcrop, Elizabeth Mahon outcrop, Innocent Bystander rock, Good Question outcrop, Fuzzy Smith rock (as discussed around Table 2/Section 3.3.2)
datasets.location_coverage: Gusev crater, Home Plate region (Eastern Valley, top of Home Plate for Fuzzy Smith)
datasets.how_used: MB results were used to characterize oxidation state and alteration (MAI) of silica-rich and related materials, assess whether silica-rich grains are coatings vs bulk (following prior work), and evaluate consistency with acid-sulfate leaching vs precipitation scenarios.

datasets.pds_dataset_product_name: MER Spirit Microscopic Imager (MI) close-up images (examples cited throughout)
datasets.measurement_observable: Microscale morphology/texture (porosity, brecciation, grain size/shape) in broadband visible
datasets.acquisition_date_time_range: Sols explicitly cited for MI examples include: 809 (Halley), 1027 (Graham Land / King George Island), 1070 (Montalva brushed spot), 1080 (Riquelme), 1101 (Puenta Arenas), 1157 (Elizabeth Mahon), 1189 (Kenosha Comets), 1198 (Lefty Ganote), 1225 (Nancy Warren), 1232 (Darlene Mickelsen), 1251–1252 (Innocent Bystander), 1291 (Norma Luker), 1796 (Stapledon)
datasets.location_coverage: Gusev crater, Home Plate region (Eastern Valley, Low Ridge/Troll, North Valley)
datasets.how_used: MI images were used to document microtextures of silica-rich nodular outcrops and soils (porous/spongy texture, brecciation/clasts, soil contamination), evaluate evidence for primary vs erosional textures, and support interpretations of sinter-like vs leached-residue origins.

datasets.pds_dataset_product_name: MER Spirit Engineering Cameras (Navcam/Hazcam) images (mosaics/anaglyphs cited for context and stratigraphy)
datasets.measurement_observable: Grayscale stereo/context imaging for geomorphology, target context, rover interaction with outcrops/soils
datasets.acquisition_date_time_range: Sols explicitly cited for context examples include: 1096 (Tyrone Nodules stereo mosaic), 1113 (Kobal Navcam mosaic/anaglyph), 1121 (Good Question/Clara Zaph context), 1196 (Gertrude Weise/Ethel Boyce context), 1232 (Nancy Warren context), plus other sol-referenced mosaics in figure captions/text
datasets.location_coverage: Gusev crater, Home Plate region (Eastern Valley, Tyrone area, and near Home Plate)
datasets.how_used: Used for geologic context: mapping nodular outcrop morphology, demonstrating rover driving over nodular outcrops without deformation, showing relationships between silica-rich nodular outcrops and buff-colored platy units, and locating Mini-TES/Pancam/IDD targets in broader scenes.

output_parsed.paper_title: Characteristics, distribution, origin, and significance of opaline silica observed by the Spirit rover in Gusev crater, Mars

queries.query: I need Spirit rover Mini-TES thermal-infrared emissivity spectra that have already been processed to minimize the internal-optics dust artifact, so I can robustly detect opal-A diagnostic structure (including the low-wavenumber silica band) and evaluate viewing-geometry/scattering effects for targets encountered around the Home Plate region in Gusev crater.

I need Spirit rover Mini-TES calibrated radiance spectra covering the full mission time span so I can independently derive emissivity and quantify the impact of the mirror/optics dust contamination using repeat observations and scene temperature contrasts, then compare pre- and post-contamination spectra for silica-rich and dust-dominated surfaces in Gusev crater.

output_parsed.paper_title: Characteristics, distribution, origin, and significance of opaline silica observed by the Spirit rover in Gusev crater, Mars

queries.query: For the Spirit rover Panoramic Camera 13-filter visible/near-IR observations acquired in Gusev crater during the Home Plate campaign (roughly sols 770–1300), generate calibrated I/F (Lambert albedo) multispectral spectra from images and apply the 934–1009 nm hydration-signature spectral-parameter criteria to map hydrated/silica-rich surface materials at outcrop and disturbed-soil scale.

Using Spirit rover Panoramic Camera derived true-color and false-color mosaics/panoramas spanning the Home Plate region (including Eastern Valley and the North Valley floor), compile color context products to document the geomorphic distribution and surface expression of light-toned, silica-rich nodular outcrops and wheel-disturbed soils across key traverses and winter-haven viewpoints.

output_parsed.paper_title: Characteristics, distribution, origin, and significance of opaline silica observed by the Spirit rover in Gusev crater, Mars

queries.query: Retrieve raw Alpha Particle X-ray Spectrometer measurements from the Mars Exploration Rover Spirit mission over the full surface-operations interval, so I can reprocess the APXS X-ray spectra for Gusev crater contact targets near Home Plate and independently evaluate elemental enrichments associated with silica-rich soils and outcrops.

Assemble APXS-derived oxide weight-percent chemistry (e.g., SiO2, TiO2, SO3, FeO, MgO, CaO, Na2O, K2O) for Mars Exploration Rover contact-science targets, then subset to Spirit rover observations in Gusev crater to quantify silica enrichment and perform simple two-endmember soil-contamination subtraction against typical regolith compositions.

queries.query: For Mars Exploration Rover Spirit investigations in Gusev crater (Home Plate region), use contact Mössbauer measurements with summed spectra to quantify Fe-bearing phase proportions and compute redox state (Fe3+/Fetotal) and a mineralogical alteration index for silica-enriched outcrops versus disturbed soils.

Reprocess raw contact Mössbauer measurements acquired by the Spirit rover on Mars to evaluate how fitting choices and surface contamination affect inferred Fe-mineral assemblages and oxidation state across Gusev crater materials, including silica-enriched targets.

output_parsed.paper_title: Characteristics, distribution, origin, and significance of opaline silica observed by the Spirit rover in Gusev crater, Mars

queries.query: Assemble the complete set of uncalibrated (EDR-level) Mars Exploration Rover Spirit Microscopic Imager observations acquired on Mars during the 2004–2010 surface mission interval to examine microscale porosity, grain-size distributions, and brecciated textures in Gusev crater outcrops and disturbed soils.

Assemble the radiometrically calibrated (RDR-level) Mars Exploration Rover Spirit Microscopic Imager image products from the 2004–2010 surface mission interval to support quantitative comparisons of brightness and texture across MI close-ups (including mosaics and stereo products) in the Gusev crater Home Plate region.

queries.query: I need Spirit rover Navigation Camera calibrated radiance images acquired during the Home Plate campaign in Gusev crater (roughly sols 1090–1235) to generate stereo mosaics/anaglyphs for geomorphic mapping of silica-rich nodular outcrops and their stratigraphic relationships with adjacent platy units.

I need Spirit rover Hazard Avoidance Camera grayscale stereo/context imaging from the Home Plate region in Gusev crater (roughly sols 1090–1235) to document rover wheel–surface interactions and local-scale stratigraphic context around nodular outcrops and disturbed soils.

final_output.query: I need the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter HiRISE red-band map-projected reduced-data image that covers the Home Plate volcanic plateau and adjacent Eastern Valley/Tyrone terrains in Gusev crater, to use as an orbital basemap for mapping the distribution of silica-rich nodular outcrops.

Provide the PDS context metadata record for the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter HiRISE imager so I can track instrument provenance and observational context for orbital reflectance/brightness imaging over Gusev crater (including the Home Plate region).

I need Spirit rover Mini-TES thermal-infrared emissivity spectra that have already been processed to minimize the internal-optics dust artifact, so I can robustly detect opal-A diagnostic structure (including the low-wavenumber silica band) and evaluate viewing-geometry/scattering effects for targets encountered around the Home Plate region in Gusev crater.

I need Spirit rover Mini-TES calibrated radiance spectra covering the full mission time span so I can independently derive emissivity and quantify the impact of the mirror/optics dust contamination using repeat observations and scene temperature contrasts, then compare pre- and post-contamination spectra for silica-rich and dust-dominated surfaces in Gusev crater.

For the Spirit rover Panoramic Camera 13-filter visible/near-IR observations acquired in Gusev crater during the Home Plate campaign (roughly sols 770–1300), generate calibrated I/F (Lambert albedo) multispectral spectra from images and apply the 934–1009 nm hydration-signature spectral-parameter criteria to map hydrated/silica-rich surface materials at outcrop and disturbed-soil scale.

Using Spirit rover Panoramic Camera derived true-color and false-color mosaics/panoramas spanning the Home Plate region (including Eastern Valley and the North Valley floor), compile color context products to document the geomorphic distribution and surface expression of light-toned, silica-rich nodular outcrops and wheel-disturbed soils across key traverses and winter-haven viewpoints.

Retrieve raw Alpha Particle X-ray Spectrometer measurements from the Mars Exploration Rover Spirit mission over the full surface-operations interval, so I can reprocess the APXS X-ray spectra for Gusev crater contact targets near Home Plate and independently evaluate elemental enrichments associated with silica-rich soils and outcrops.

Assemble APXS-derived oxide weight-percent chemistry (e.g., SiO2, TiO2, SO3, FeO, MgO, CaO, Na2O, K2O) for Mars Exploration Rover contact-science targets, then subset to Spirit rover observations in Gusev crater to quantify silica enrichment and perform simple two-endmember soil-contamination subtraction against typical regolith compositions.

For Mars Exploration Rover Spirit investigations in Gusev crater (Home Plate region), use contact Mössbauer measurements with summed spectra to quantify Fe-bearing phase proportions and compute redox state (Fe3+/Fetotal) and a mineralogical alteration index for silica-enriched outcrops versus disturbed soils.

Reprocess raw contact Mössbauer measurements acquired by the Spirit rover on Mars to evaluate how fitting choices and surface contamination affect inferred Fe-mineral assemblages and oxidation state across Gusev crater materials, including silica-enriched targets.

Assemble the complete set of uncalibrated (EDR-level) Mars Exploration Rover Spirit Microscopic Imager observations acquired on Mars during the 2004–2010 surface mission interval to examine microscale porosity, grain-size distributions, and brecciated textures in Gusev crater outcrops and disturbed soils.

Assemble the radiometrically calibrated (RDR-level) Mars Exploration Rover Spirit Microscopic Imager image products from the 2004–2010 surface mission interval to support quantitative comparisons of brightness and texture across MI close-ups (including mosaics and stereo products) in the Gusev crater Home Plate region.

I need Spirit rover Navigation Camera calibrated radiance images acquired during the Home Plate campaign in Gusev crater (roughly sols 1090–1235) to generate stereo mosaics/anaglyphs for geomorphic mapping of silica-rich nodular outcrops and their stratigraphic relationships with adjacent platy units.

I need Spirit rover Hazard Avoidance Camera grayscale stereo/context imaging from the Home Plate region in Gusev crater (roughly sols 1090–1235) to document rover wheel–surface interactions and local-scale stratigraphic context around nodular outcrops and disturbed soils.
